account.title: Accounts
account.credential_mode_hint_login: Enter the username and password; rDownloader signs in and renews the session on its own. The session lives in rDownloader's own cookie store – your browser stays signed out, and that is not a fault.
account.credential_mode_hint_api_key: Paste the provider's API key. Downloads additionally need a cookie session pasted below.
account.cookies_placeholder: Cookie: name=value; … or Netscape cookie file
account.hint_generic: Enter the credentials required by this provider.
account.cookies_warning: Cookies grant access to your session. Import only the cookies of the respective provider and never share the content.
account.connect_instructions: Open this address and confirm the sign-in there. Nothing is opened for you — check the address before you go.
account.connect_waiting: Waiting for you to confirm. You can close this page; the sign-in carries on.
account.connect_done: Signed in. The credential is stored.
account.hint_oauth_client: From your own OAuth application at the provider. rDownloader ships no client id of its own; the sign-in itself runs at the provider.

browser_session.take_over_hint: Take over the session your browser is signed in to {host} with, through the rDownloader extension, for this account
browser_session.waiting: Waiting for the browser extension: open it in the browser that is signed in to {host} and hand the session over for this account.
browser_session.consent: The extension asks you once more there, and the browser asks for permission for {host}. Only cookies of {host} are handed over; rDownloader stores them encrypted with this account.
browser_session.extension_missing: No browser extension has checked in recently. Without one, the session cannot arrive.
browser_session.delivered: The {host} session arrived and is stored with this account; the account is being checked now.
browser_session.declined: Declined in the extension: the {host} session was not handed over.
browser_session.expired: Nobody answered the request in time; the {host} session was not handed over.

hosters.description: Links from these hosters are loaded automatically through this account unless a dedicated provider account applies. The list is provided by the provider's plugin.
hosters.empty: No hoster list available (plugin not installed or provider unreachable).

delete.title: Delete provider account
delete.description: The account "{label}" and its encrypted credentials will be deleted. Unfinished downloads protect the account from deletion.
